headline: Ukraine and UK Partner to Manufacture Long-Range Drones in Britain
summary: Defense officials from Ukraine and the United Kingdom signed agreements to co-produce Ukrainian middle- and deep-strike drones in Britain, financed by British funding for direct delivery to Ukraine's military.
why: Defense procurement partnerships between European nations and Ukraine represent significant expansion in UK defense technology manufacturing.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: UK manufacturing facilities will produce Ukrainian-designed defense drones under bilateral funding.
